sentiment.rationale: Forward guidance was reduced significantly: FY26 EBIT guidance is USD -1.5bn to +1.0bn, compared to FY25 EBIT of USD 3.5bn (which was at the upper end of prior guidance). Management explicitly cites industry overcapacity and Red Sea reopening scenarios as headwinds. The share buyback was reduced from USD 2.0bn to USD 1.0bn, reflecting a more cautious approach. The tone is defensive about the Ocean outlook, with management emphasizing cost discipline and uncertainty.

summary.revenue: Q4 2025 revenue USD 13.3bn, down 8.7% YoY (from USD 14.6bn). FY25 revenue USD 54.0bn, down 2.7% YoY (from USD 55.5bn).
summary.eps: Not disclosed. Underlying profit for FY25 was USD 6,095m (vs USD 2,774m in FY24). Earnings per share (USD) not provided in the document.
summary.guidance: FY26 underlying EBITDA USD 4.5bn to 7.0bn; underlying EBIT USD -1.5bn to +1.0bn; free cash flow ≥ USD 3bn; global container volume growth 2-4%; Maersk to grow in line with market. Capex FY26-27 combined USD 10-11bn.
summary.margin: Q4 2025 EBIT margin 0.9% (down from 14.0% in Q4 2024). FY25 EBIT margin 6.5% (down from 11.7% in FY24). Logistics & Services EBIT margin 4.9% in Q4 (up 0.8pp YoY). Terminals EBIT margin 23.7% in Q4 (down from 28.3% in Q4 2024).
key_risks: Industry overcapacity from new vessel deliveries
Potential full Red Sea reopening in 2026, which would add further capacity
Freight rate decline: Ocean rates down 23% YoY and 8.8% sequentially
Ocean EBIT turned negative in Q4 2025 at USD -153m
Logistics & Services still below 6% EBIT margin target
Trade tensions and tariff environment impacting US-China volumes
Labour inflation and FX impact on Terminals cost per move
key_opportunities: Gemini network delivering cost savings of USD 820-1,100m annually
Terminals record performance with 20% revenue growth and 31% EBIT growth in FY25
Logistics & Services seventh consecutive quarter of YoY EBIT margin improvement
Strong balance sheet with net cash of USD 2.9bn to weather downturn
Continued share buyback program of USD 1.0bn over 12 months
Organisational cost reductions of USD 180m annually from corporate overhead

management_tone.label: cautious
management_tone.justification: Management repeatedly emphasizes uncertainty and headwinds: 'The lower level reflects the higher level of uncertainty and the lower rate environment that we are headed into in 2026' and 'we are, of course, prudent towards capital deployment and keeping as much of our powder dry as possible, given some of the unknowns in the outlook.'
